info.name: Odoo 19 Community – Complete HR API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection covering 60+ models across ALL HR-related modules in Odoo 19.0 Community Edition.

Modules covered: hr, hr_attendance, hr_holidays, hr_recruitment, hr_expense, hr_timesheet, hr_skills, hr_work_entry, hr_homeworking, hr_presence, hr_org_chart, hr_fleet, hr_hourly_cost, fleet, maintenance, gamification, resource, calendar, analytic.

Usage:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Edit collection variables (base_url, db_name, username, password)
3. Run '00 – Authentication › Login' first to capture the session cookie
4. All subsequent requests automatically use the session cookie

exec: // Automatically set Content-Type for all requests
pm.test('JSON-RPC response has no error', function () {
